Method:-
In a large, deep saucepan or deep fat fryer, heat oil to 180 degrees C.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, beer, salt and pepper. Mix until smooth. Dredge onion slices in the batter, until evenly coated.
Deep fry in the hot oil until golden brown. Drain on kithen roll. Serve hot.
